description: Tactical decision taxonomy and algorithmic resolution engine for Battle System 2.0 (V2) omens, counter abilities, and guard fallbacks.

hit_count.description: Fulfills omens requiring 20 to 97 hits in a single turn.
tacticalSequence: 1. Dispatch multi-hit damage abilities (e.g. Decimate, Acrobat Volley, Manadiver Leviathan crest nukes).
2. Activate Team Echoes / Bonus Damage buffs (Frame A, Frame B, or Frame D weapon skills).
3. Ensure Guaranteed Triple Attack / Quadruple Attack buffs are active.
4. Trigger extra attack instances (e.g. Luchador Tag Team, Double Strike buffs, Sun summon call).
5. Normal attack execution calculates: Hits = (Characters * Attacks * (1 + EchoCount)) + SkillHits.
hit_count.guardFallbackSafety: Safe for elemental hits; caution against high plain damage triggers.

damage_threshold.description: Fulfills omens requiring 10M to 30M damage in a single turn.
tacticalSequence: 1. Ensure boss has -50% Defense Down applied (Miserable Mist + Armor Break / Elemental DEF Down).
2. Activate Assassin buffs (Anytime Assassin, Path of Destruction, Salt).
3. Dispatch high-multiplier damage summons (Beelzebub 3M plain + Borehole debuff, Triple Zero 6.66M, Bahamut 250%).
4. Combine Full Chain charge attacks with supplemental damage buffs.
damage_threshold.guardFallbackSafety: Safe for standard damage omens; Guard reduces incoming damage by 90%.

skill_damage.description: Fulfills omens requiring 10 to 15 instances of skill damage or 10M+ skill damage.
tacticalSequence: 1. Prioritize multi-hit damage skills with supplemental skill damage buffs (e.g. World weapons / Agonize / Pain of the Fallen).
2. Leverage auto-activating end-of-turn or after-attack skill nukes (e.g. Manadiver Lu Woh/Leviathan crests, Monk martial prowess).
3. Reset skill cooldowns where possible (e.g. Qilin call if available or character CD reset passives).
skill_damage.guardFallbackSafety: Safe to Guard if skill cooldowns are depleted.

charge_attack_count.description: Fulfills omens requiring 3 to 6 Charge Attacks in a single turn.
tacticalSequence: 1. Verify Charge Attack toggle is ON (.btn-auto / .btn-lock or manual C.A. toggle).
2. If charge bar is insufficient, activate 100% team battery (Relic Buster Tactical Shield + Limit Burst, or Huanglong call).
3. For 5+ ougi requirements, deploy Kengo with Unsigned Kaneshige or characters with innate dual-ougi passives.
charge_attack_count.guardFallbackSafety: Safe to Guard if charge bar generation cannot reach 400% aggregate.

fatal_chain.description: Fulfills omens requiring immediate discharge of 100% Fatal Chain.
tacticalSequence: 1. Inspect in-page Fatal Chain gauge (must be == 100%).
2. If gauge == 100%, trigger DOM button: .btn-fatal-chain.
3. If gauge < 100%, evaluate whether full chain ougi this turn can push gauge to 100% (each ougi adds 10%, 4-chain full burst adds 50% total).
4. If impossible to fill, activate Guard on all characters.
fatal_chain.guardFallbackSafety: Extremely critical. Fatal Chain omens often carry 99,999 Plain damage or massive lethal wipes. Guarding reduces damage to survivable levels.

dispel.description: Fulfills omens requiring 1 to 4 dispels in a single turn.
tacticalSequence: 1. Call Beelzebub summon (guaranteed 3 dispels on call).
2. Dispatch character single or double dispel abilities.
3. Trigger charge attacks for characters with Dispel-on-C.A. (e.g. Vampy, Halluel & Malluel, G.Percival).
dispel.guardFallbackSafety: Guarding prevents damage, but failing to dispel leaves boss with lethal permanent buffs (e.g. 100% ATK up, Damage Cut, or Debuff Immunity).

debuff_count.description: Fulfills omens requiring 5 to 12 debuffs landed in a single turn.
tacticalSequence: 1. First cast Debuff Resistance Down to ensure subsequent debuffs do not miss.
2. Dispatch multi-debuff abilities (Miserable Mist lands 2 debuffs; Chaos Ruler / Lich / Fediel land 4-6 debuffs each).
3. Call summons that inflict multiple status ailments (Beelzebub lands 3 ailments, Sariel lands 2).
debuff_count.guardFallbackSafety: Safe to Guard if debuff cooldowns are exhausted.

cancelableOmen.conditionCheckMet: Execute attack and skill sequence to cancel omen, reset diamonds to 0, and maintain full DPS.
cancelableOmen.conditionCheckUnmet: Do NOT attempt blind attacks. Dispatch .btn-guard-all to reduce incoming damage by 90%.

uncancelableOmen.action: Always engage Guard (.btn-guard-all) or 100% All-Cut invulnerability, unless sacrificial unit mechanics are specifically intended.

guardPhysics.plainDamageMitigation: Reduces fixed/plain damage by 90% in Battle System 2.0 (e.g. 100k Plain becomes 10k Plain).
penalties: Guarded character cannot attack or deal damage.
Guarded character cannot gain charge bar from attacking.
